title: Fourteen Autumns and One Short Subject
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：email　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 email 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1997 my teacher ① sent an email that no colleague in the office would have answered, and he said the sending was the whole of the autumn. The ② email, meaning the message and not the system, ran fourteen autumns and stayed unnamed in the book; an email, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unanswered.

Every ③ email in that office had the same short subject at the end of it, and the ④ email at the end, meaning the one they kept for the headmaster and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An email, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to answer; my teacher said the answering is the part that fills fourteen autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the email was the whole of the story, meaning the system and not the message. The ⑥ email, meaning the system and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody uses and nobody manages; email, he said, is either something you send or the only word that means both a message and a system. He said the system is the part they remember.

By 2006 the ⑦ email had become a line in an archive, and the archive had become an argument about the short subject. The ⑧ email of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in October, was one office and fourteen autumns of answering; email, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to answer. She said the answering was never mentioned.

The ⑨ email I remember is the one named in the archive, which was lost in 2018 and is still described as the quietest in the office. An ⑩ email, my mother said in 2020, is the only one that improves by being answered; every email, she said, is a system that has agreed to look like a message. She said the system was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 电子邮件（指那间办公室里发出的那一封）
B. n. 电子邮件（指那封邮件本身，与邮件系统相对）
C. 固定搭配：send an email 发一封电子邮件
D. n. 电子邮件（指留给校长的那一封）
E. n. 电子邮件（抽象总称，指一间办公室的通信之事）
F. n. 电子邮件（指归档里写到、被列名的那一封）

answers.why: send an email 意为“发一封电子邮件”，1997 年老师发了一封办公室里没有一位同事肯回复的邮件。
email 意为“电子邮件”，指那封邮件本身而不是邮件系统，它经过了十四个秋天而在簿子上没有名字。
email 意为“电子邮件”，指那间办公室里的每一封邮件，每一封前头都有同一行短短的主题。
email 意为“电子邮件”，指留给校长的那一封，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
email 意为“电子邮件系统、邮件服务”，指故事里人人都用却无人管理的那样东西，叔叔说这套邮件系统就是那个故事的全部。
email 意为“邮件系统”，指人人都用却无人管理的那种服务而不是那封邮件，是故事里人人都用、却无人管理的东西。
email 意为“电子邮件”，指归档里写到、被列名的那一封，到 2006 年这封邮件成了归档里的一行。
email 意为“电子邮件”，老师十月写道，整件事的通信之事是一间办公室和十四个秋天的回复。
email 意为“电子邮件”，我记得的是归档里列名的那一封，2018 年丢了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一封。
email 为抽象总称，母亲 2020 年说，一封电子邮件是唯一会因为被好好回复而变得更好的东西。
